international.title: Russell Brand to be sentenced for rape and sexual assault today – latest updates
international.summary: Disgraced comedian was convicted last week and was warned he faces a ‘signficant’ prison term The jury of eight men and four women deliberated for more than eight hours last week to return a unanimous verdict where they found Brand guilty on four of the seven charges. He was found guilty of one count of rape and three incidents of sexual assault. He was acquitted of two rape counts and one attempted incident. He was convicted of sexually assaulting a woman at a colleague’s birthday party in a bar in Soho, London in 2004, but found not guilty of orally raping her in a bathroom. He was found guilty of kissing and groping another woman at a London radio station in 2004 or 2005 He was convicted of anally raping a fan at his home after meeting her backstage at one of his comedy shows in 2009 He was found guilty of sexually assaulting a woman who says the comedian demanded a massage and pressed his face into her groin during an advert recording in 2009.
